meta.name: alfworld-navigation-planner
meta.description: Plans a path to move the agent between receptacles to search for target objects. Use this when you need to traverse the environment to reach a specific location or systematically explore multiple areas. It takes the current location and destination receptacle as input, and outputs the next 'go to' action to approach the target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划导航路径，在环境中移动并搜索目标物体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中自动规划移动路径
copy.tagline_en: Plan navigation paths to move and search for target objects in the environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically plan movement paths in a virtual environment

howto.what: 当你在室内环境需要移动到特定容器（如桌子、抽屉）时，Claude 会规划从当前位置到目标容器的路径，并输出下一步“go to”动作。
howto.when: 当需要移动到某个具体位置（如从床到桌子），或系统性搜索多个区域时触发。

say.text: 从 bed 1 导航到 desk 1。
帮我系统搜索 desklamp，先去 desk 1。

howto.what_en: Claude plans a path from your current location to a target receptacle (like a desk or drawer) and outputs the next 'go to' action to get there.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to move to a specific location or systematically explore multiple areas in a household environment.

say_en.text: Search for desklamp systematically, go to desk 1 first.
